summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for relay coil with diode suppression, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The diode-suppressed relay form combines the operating element with a documented suppression component. The coil and diode connection establishes polarity requirements and can affect release behaviour, so the assembled relay or socket diagram is relevant.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace suppression polarity before evaluating the control supply.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A coil suppression diode and a rectifier in the power path serve different circuit functions.
